jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT KERNEL

AI agents are starting to do sales, procurement and operations work. They need to know which company they are dealing with.



Most company data is in CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets. Records are duplicated, parent companies are missing, and addresses are outdated. This costs sales teams revenue and leaves operations and finance teams with avoidable risk and bad debt. Agents need a business identity layer they can trust.



Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. Every business gets a permanent KERN ID, along with the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel in their own systems, and we expect agents to use it far more.



We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.




THE ROLE

You’ll be Kernel’s Product Marketing Lead, building product marketing from the ground up. There’s a lot of potential here, and you’ll set the direction.



Your mission: make Kernel easy to understand and easy to buy, for customers and for the partners who sell it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own positioning and narrative: for customers we sell to directly and for our partners.

 - Write the technical story: work with Anders,  Marcus, and Zak on product positioning and technical documentation.

 - Own announcements and launches: plan each one and get it out.

 - Equip sales: work with the sales team on messaging, demos and battlecards.

 - Build our social proof: case studies and customer references.

 - 5% “other stuff”: events, the website and anything else that helps the business.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Most important is product marketing experience at a high-growth startup and examples of work that had a real impact on the business.

 - You have written technical content before.

 - You have led large projects such as a launch or a repositioning, and set the plan yourself.

 - You work fast and closely with sales and the founders.

 - You have taste and you execute well.

 - Experience with video content is a plus but not a requirement.




⚠️ THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF YOU:

 - Need other product marketers around you to work best.

 - Prefer to be handed a brief than to write one.

 - Need perfect clarity before starting.

 - Prefer long cycles and big “reveals.”

 - Want fully remote work (we move faster in-person).




WHAT WE OFFER

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

 - 💰 Salary: £90,000 – £120,000 base + equity

 - 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

 - 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

 - ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

 - 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

 - 💼 Pension plan

 - 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

 - 🎉 Team events and dinners

 - 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

 - 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace




🎫 VISAS & RELOCATION

We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and provide relocation support for those moving to London.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Stage 1: Introductory Call with Zak, Founding Growth (30 minutes)

Stage 2: Case Study with Zak & Anders (CEO)

Final Stage: Founders Interview. A conversation with the founders focused on values alignment and long-term vision.

Following Mutual Fit: Reference checks and offer stage.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT KERNEL

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?



Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.



Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.



Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.



We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.




THE ROLE

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

 - Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

 - Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

 - Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

 - Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

 - Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a highly technical, full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.

 - Scar tissue: 6+ years of Product Management experience, where you’ve learnt the hard way what works and what doesn’t, and built complex products and features along the way

 - Evals: Comfortable with evals for agents and driving quality improvements via evals and recursive self-improvement

 - Technical IQ: Comfortable with API, data pipelines, SQL, and so on. Even (and especially) when Claude Code is down.

 - Extreme ownership: You own your area, cradle-to-grave; this is not a relay race where you only do one part and then hand off the next bit of product work to someone else

 - Clever use of AI: You’re an aggressive and proficient user of AI, but you never switch off the local LLM that you were born with :)




⚠️ THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF YOU

 - Want to work remotely. This role is in our London office at least four days a week; most of the team does five.

 - Don't enjoy the pace and intensity of an early-stage startup

 - Have side projects or want to manage a team immediately

 - Need perfect clarity before starting.

 - Prefer long cycles and big “reveals.”




WHAT WE OFFER

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

 - 💰 Salary: £115K - £145K base + equity

 - 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

 - 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

 - ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

 - 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

 - 💼 Pension plan

 - 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

 - 🎉 Team events and dinners

 - 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

 - 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Stage 1 - Screening Call with Hiring Manager

Stage 2 - Case study (onsite) 

Stage 3 - Founders values interview
